## About
Ace Veterinary Clinic is an out-patient, appointment-based clinic in San Antonio caring for dogs and cats. Our mission is to provide quality medicine at an affordable price for out-patient services.
Dr. Lan and vet techs Angela, Abigail, Deanna, Emily, Marissa and Nicole handle exams, vaccines, in-house SNAP tests and microscopic exams, and treatment for skin, ear, eye, urinary and digestive problems. Advanced bloodwork goes out to IDEXX Reference Laboratories and is reviewed by board-certified veterinary pathologists.
We are clear about what we don't do here: no surgery, spay and neuter, dental cleanings, X-rays, hospitalization, grooming or boarding. For those, please contact a full-service veterinary hospital.

## Services
- Comprehensive Exams: Wellness checks and general sick-pet consultations for dogs and cats.
- Preventative Care: Low-cost vaccinations and deworming, microchipping, and flea, tick and heartworm prevention.
- Hygienic Maintenance: Professional nail trims, ingrown nail care, anal gland expression and ear cleanings.
- Out-Patient medical Treatments: Care for skin infections and allergies, eye and ear problems, urinary tract infections, digestive upsets, upper respiratory infections, minor wounds and bee stings.
- In-House SNAP Tests: Rapid results for heartworm, Ehrlichia, Anaplasma, Lyme, Parvo, Giardia, pancreatitis and more, plus in-house microscopic exams.
- Mass & Lump Evaluations: FNA cytology sent to the IDEXX lab for a closer look at lumps.
- Chronic Pain Care: Long-term arthritis and joint pain management.
- Humane Euthanasia: Compassionate end-of-life care for dogs, starting with a gentle sedation so your pet is comfortable and calm. Cremation service handling if requested.

## FAQ
Q: How do I book an appointment?
A: Text our mobile line at 210-264-7410. Texting is the fastest way to reach us.

Q: Can my pet be seen today?
A: Often, yes. We have same-day appointments available on a lot of days. Text us to check availability.

Q: What if my pet needs help after hours?
A: Outside our 7:30 AM to 1:00 PM hours, please contact a 24/7 ER facility right away. Our Emergency Contact page lists options such as Thrive Pet Healthcare Specialists and Mission Vet Specialty and Emergency.

Q: Do you do surgery, dental cleanings or X-rays?
A: No. We don't offer surgery, spay and neuter, dental cleanings, X-rays, hospitalization, health certificates for travel, grooming or boarding. For these, please contact a full-service veterinary hospital.

Q: How can I pay?
A: We accept credit cards, CareCredit, the Cherry payment plan and cash. We don't accept personal checks.
